description: Container resource investigation. Which container is responsible and what's it doing?

links.title: Host Workbench
links.tooltip: VM-level metrics: CPU, memory, disk, I/O

panels.description: Number of containers seen by cAdvisor within the last 120 seconds across the selected scope.

targets.expr: count(container_last_seen{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""} > (time() - 120))

panels.title: Containers Running

panels.description: Count of containers using more than 50% of a CPU core. Zero is healthy.

targets.expr: count(sum by (host,service)(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval])) > 0.5) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: CPU Heavy

panels.description: Containers using more than 25% of their host's total RAM, named directly. No container here sets a Docker memory limit, so pressure is measured against host memory instead. Click a tile to focus the dashboard on that container.

targets.expr: sum by (host,service) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}) / on(host) group_left() max by (host)(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host"}) > 0.25

panels.title: Memory Pressure

panels.description: Containers with failing Docker health checks (starting or unhealthy). Excludes containers without health checks.

targets.expr: count(container_health_state{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""} == 0 or container_health_state{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""} >= 2) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Health Issues

panels.description: Total OOM kills across all containers. Should always be 0.

targets.expr: sum(container_oom_events_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: OOM Events

panels.description: Containers that started within the current dashboard time range — indicates a restart or fresh deployment.

targets.expr: count(container_start_time_seconds{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""} > (time() - $__range_s)) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Recent Restarts

panels.description: All containers on selected hosts ranked by CPU. Click a service name to focus this dashboard on that container, or use View Logs to jump to the Log Workbench.

targets.expr: sum by (host,service)(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (host,service)(container_memory_working_set_bytes{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""})
sum by (host,service)(rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (host,service)(rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
time() - max by (host,service)(container_start_time_seconds{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""})
sum by (host,service)(rate(container_fs_writes_bytes_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Container Resource Table

panels.description: Containers that have Docker health checks configured, with their current status. Unhealthy and starting containers sort to the top.

targets.expr: container_health_state{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""} != -1

panels.title: Health Check Status

panels.description: Containers that started within the current time range — indicates a restart or fresh deployment. Click a service name to view logs around the restart.

targets.expr: container_start_time_seconds{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""} * 1000 > (time() - $__range_s) * 1000

panels.title: Recent Restarts

panels.description: CPU usage per container (fraction of one core). Narrow $service to focus on a single container.

targets.expr: sum by (service) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Container CPU

panels.description: Working set memory per container (what the OOM killer uses). No container here sets a Docker memory limit, so there is no limit line — judge usage against the host's total RAM on the Host Workbench.

targets.expr: sum by (service) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""})

panels.title: Container Memory

panels.description: Network throughput per container, colored by service (each container gets a consistent color across panels). Receive (positive, solid line) and transmit (negative, dashed line) form a bidirectional view — direction is encoded by sign + line style, not color, so it stays readable with many services selected.

targets.expr: sum by (service) (rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
- sum by (service) (rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Container Network

panels.description: RSS = actual memory the container needs (what OOM killer considers), solid line. Cache = kernel page cache (reclaimable), dashed line. Both colored by service so containers stay distinguishable when $service=All. High cache is normal for database and log-heavy containers; high RSS with an upward trend indicates a memory leak.

targets.expr: sum by (service)(container_memory_rss{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""})
sum by (service)(container_memory_cache{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""})

panels.title: Memory: RSS vs Cache

panels.description: Container filesystem write (positive, solid) and read (negative, dashed) rates, colored by service. High write rates from Prometheus, Loki, or databases are normal; unexpected spikes from app containers may indicate issues.

targets.expr: sum by (service)(rate(container_fs_writes_bytes_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))
- sum by (service)(rate(container_fs_reads_bytes_total{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Disk I/O

panels.description: Number of times each container's start time changed within the current time range — a true restart COUNT, not just 'started at least once'. The Recent Restarts table above only shows the most recent start; a container silently crash-looping (e.g. 5 restarts in an hour) looks identical to a single clean restart there. This panel makes that visible.

targets.expr: changes(container_start_time_seconds{node=~"$node", vm_role=~"$vm_role", host=~"$host", service=~"$service", name!="", image!=""}[$__range]) > 0
